name: Cave Badger
sourcePageKind: The public D&D Beyond monster index identifies this exact Out of the Abyss entry as a Beast. The linked official creature page redirected to the book purchase page without access.
errataEvidence: No change to this entry in the official Out of the Abyss errata v1.1 or the D&D Beyond errata page.
appearanceEvidence: Editorial description of the selected parchment portrait and the shape stated or implied by the printed creature account.
artworkNote: Reuses the previously staged Giant Badger portrait for the adventure variant.
sourceNotes: The adventure gives AC 12 from natural armor, 60 ft. tremorsense, and a 15-ft. burrow speed. Darkvision comes from the inherited Giant Badger block.
